content_en.prompt: Some beavers are allergic to certain wood types. Anita makes wood snacks (from 6 types: Ash/Maple/Oak/Birch/Poplar/Willow) for a party; each guest can eat certain woods safely, and beavers share snacks. Guest list: Anita(Willow,Oak,Ash,Maple), Beena(Willow,Oak,Poplar), Chaitanya(Oak), Dinesh(Ash,Birch), Esha(Willow,Maple,Birch), Firoz(Oak,Ash), Ganga(Poplar,Maple).
content_en.question: What is the minimum number of dishes Anita can bring so everyone can eat without getting sick?
content_en.explanation: Anita must make Oak for Chaitanya, which also satisfies Anita, Beena, Firoz. No single dish covers the remaining three (Dinesh, Esha, Ganga), so at least 2 more dishes are needed — e.g. Ash+Maple, or Poplar+Birch, or Maple+Birch. Total: 3 dishes.
content_en.ct_explanation: This is a classic bipartite graph / Set Cover problem: each dish is a set of beavers who can eat it, and the goal is to select the fewest sets whose union covers everyone. Set Cover is one of the hardest (NP-complete) problems in computer science — no efficient general algorithm exists, and brute-force becomes infeasible fast. This task was solvable because it was small and had limited options.

content_zh.prompt: 有些海狸對特定木頭種類過敏。Anita要準備木頭點心參加派對（共6種木頭：白蠟木、楓木、橡木、樺木、白楊木、柳木），每位賓客只能安全吃某幾種木頭，而且海狸們願意分享點心。賓客清單：Anita(柳木、橡木、白蠟木、楓木)、Beena(柳木、橡木、白楊木)、Chaitanya(橡木)、Dinesh(白蠟木、樺木)、Esha(柳木、楓木、樺木)、Firoz(橡木、白蠟木)、Ganga(白楊木、楓木)。
content_zh.question: Anita最少要準備幾道點心，才能讓所有賓客都吃得安心？
content_zh.explanation: Anita一定要做橡木口味給Chaitanya，這道也剛好滿足Anita、Beena、Firoz。剩下Dinesh、Esha、Ganga三人沒有共通的口味，所以至少還要再準備2道——例如白蠟木+楓木，或白楊木+樺木，或楓木+樺木。總共3道。
content_zh.ct_skills: 抽象化（Abstraction）、演算法思維（Algorithmic Thinking）
content_zh.ct_explanation: 這是經典的「二分圖」／「集合覆蓋問題」：每道菜可以看成一個「能吃這道菜的海狸」集合，目標是選出最少數量的集合，讓所有海狸都被涵蓋到。集合覆蓋問題是資訊科學中數一數二困難的問題（屬於NP-complete），目前沒有已知的高效率通用演算法——組合數量一多，窮舉法就會變得不可行。這一題之所以能解出來，是因為規模小、選項有限。
